# Polskie Skille

> Open-source registry of skills for AI agents that give access to Polish services, official APIs and public data: business registers, exchange rates, weather, healthcare queues, legislation, parcels, domain warnings, air quality, procurement, property transactions, urban departures, energy prices, local statistics, parcel boundaries, GIS product warnings and Open Food Facts labels. Every skill is a SKILL.md instruction file plus a Python 3.8+ standard-library CLI that prints JSON to stdout.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/b44x/ai-polish-skills/main/AGENTS.md): discovery protocol, capability routing map and execution contract (exit codes 0/2/64/69)
- [registry.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/b44x/ai-polish-skills/main/registry/registry.json): full machine-readable index of skills, install commands and SKILL.md URLs
- [registry.min.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/b44x/ai-polish-skills/main/registry/registry.min.json): minified index

## Install

- One skill: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/b44x/ai-polish-skills/main/install.sh | bash -s <skill>`
- Skill instructions: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/b44x/ai-polish-skills/main/skills/<skill>/SKILL.md`

## Optional

- [Bundled registry](https://polskieskille.pl/assets/registry.min.json): catalogue snapshot used when the published registry cannot be reached
- [Repository](https://github.com/b44x/ai-polish-skills)
